Toddler meals

Soft cinnamon oat bake

Fahéjas zab

8 months+ Replaced 30 min 6 portions

Serve warm, soaked or crumbled into plain yogurt. Freeze slices of the bake without the yogurt, and add yogurt after thawing.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 90 g Rolled oats (Fine or ordinary oats)
  • 1 large Ripe banana (Mashed smooth)
  • 180 ml Full-fat milk (Pasteurized)
  • a pinch Ground cinnamon (Less than 1/8 teaspoon)
  • 120 g Plain full-fat yogurt (Pasteurized; for soaking or crumbling at the table)

Allergens

glutenmilk

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 180°C.
  2. Mash the banana and stir in the oats, milk, and cinnamon.
  3. Spread the mixture in a small tin.
  4. Bake until just set and still soft, about 18 minutes.
  5. Cool until warm, then soak a piece in yogurt or crumble it in.
  6. Offer small soft spoonfuls.

Replaced

Crisp granola and chopped nuts were the problem. A dry cluster can break into hard pieces that a young child can choke on.

This is a soft baked oat porridge made with banana, oats, a pinch of cinnamon, and milk. If you stir in a teaspoon of smooth almond or peanut butter that is already tolerated, thin it into the yogurt and add tree-nut or peanut to the allergens. A baby with severe eczema or a known egg allergy needs a clinician before the first peanut taste.
